config.label: A Housecall Pro API key
config.description: A Housecall Pro API key. Generated under My Apps, Go to App store, API Key Management. Requires their MAX plan and an admin login.

config.label: Set to 1 to register no tool that can change anything in Housecall Pro
config.description: Set to 1 to register no tool that can change anything in Housecall Pro.

config.label: Comma-separated groups to register: company, customers, jobs, estimates, invoices, pricebook, schedule, reports, admin
config.description: Comma-separated groups to register: company, customers, jobs, estimates, invoices, pricebook, schedule, reports, admin. Also 'all' and 'default'. Fewer tools in context makes a client choose better among them.

config.label: Comma-separated tool names to register in addition to the toolsets, e
config.description: Comma-separated tool names to register in addition to the toolsets, e.g. hcp_list_jobs. Pair with HCP_TOOLSETS=none for exactly these tools. An unknown name stops the server rather than silently registering nothing.
